questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(4)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((4)−1), initial concentration নয়।

questions.question_bn: Buffer HA/A⁻, p Ka=4। [A⁻]/[HA]=14। pH কোনটি?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Henderson–Hasselbalch pH=p Ka+log(base/acid)=4+logn; ratio উল্টো নিলে sign বদলায়।

questions.question_bn: First-order reaction half-life 19min। 75% consumed হতে কত min?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। 75% consumption means 25% remaining=(½)²। two half-lives elapsed; time 2×(19) min, not linear 75% scaling।

questions.question_bn: A⇌B-এর K=16। 2B⇌2A-এর equilibrium constant কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Reaction reverse-এ K reciprocal; coefficients double-এ square। resulting constant=(1/K)²=1/(16)²।

questions.question_bn: Gas equilibrium-এ inert gas constant volume,T-তে যোগ করলে reactant partial pressures কী হয়?
questions.explanation: Partial Pi=niRT/V। inert addition ni,T,V বদলায় না, total pressure বাড়লেও participating partial pressures unchanged।

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=64×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((8)²×10⁻⁹)=(8)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।
